consolidation.summary: All 13 checks pass. The G2 feature-ablation retrain is a clean, leakage-free, apples-to-apples contrast. Probe edit is minimal and correct; fence intact; harness unmodified; ceiling/pair counts identical across conditions; walk-forward discipline honored; headline-dilution caveat honestly stated; direction points_to=a is well-justified by the OOS +0.183 lift to ceiling.

triage_candidates.statement: OOS rw=0.7700 slightly exceeds ceiling=0.7643 on 18 events/3352 pairs (2025). This is likely within sampling variance, but the +0.183 magnitude is strong evidence. Decision on whether OOS rw~ceiling (effectively ceiling-matched) is sufficient to float an Admiral promotion decision for cross_channel_min_pace feature landing is Commander/Admiral authority, not a reviewer call. Triage candidate for §7.6.3 C3 promotion path.

Probe NaN fallback to 0.0 (when both qs_best_raw and lr_best_raw are NaN) differs from existing _nanmin2 which returns float('nan'). The 0.0 fallback is explicitly documented as 'neutral; no ordering signal' — appropriate for pairwise training where 0.0 difference means no contribution. However, for production landing, a companion _missing indicator (per the codebase sparse-neutral pattern) may improve signal. Triage candidate for production-landing review.
